To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SuperGrid protocol is simple, efficient and scalable for small to medium sized systems.

(1) for small number of replicated servers, the SuperGrid protocol is a good choice for load balancing and high availability; (2) for large number of replicated servers (greater than 100) the Crumbling Walls protocol performs better than the SuperGrid protocol; (3) the SuperGrid protocol performs better than other existing protocols when the number of replicas is small; (4) the SuperGrid and the Crumbling Walls protocols perform better than other existing quorum protocols for small number of servers
the SuperGrid protocol has a load of at least O(1//sqrt[N]) and an availability of at least exp(-/Omega//sqrt[N]).
